{{Short description|47th season of the National Hurling League}} {{Use dmy dates|date=March 2025}} {{Infobox GAA League |league = 1977–78 National Hurling League |image = |dates =9 October 1977 – 6 August 1978 |teams = |team1 = Clare |captain1 = |manager1 = |titles = 3rd |team2 = |captain2 = |manager2 = |two= Carlow |previous = [[1976–77 National Hurling League|1976–77]] |next = [[1978–79 National Hurling League|1978–79]] }} The '''1977–78 National Hurling League''' was the 47th season of the [[National Hurling League]]. ==Division 1== {{Infobox football league season | image=GAA-1978-National-Hurling-League-Final-UNOFFICIAL-PIRATE-Clare.jpg | image_size = 250 |competition=[[National Hurling League|National Hurling League Division 1]] |season=1977-78 |winners=[[Clare GAA|Clare]]
3rd National League title
Captain: [[Seán Stack]]
Manager: [[Harry Bohan]] |relegated=[[Westmeath GAA|Westmeath]] |continentalcup1= |continentalcup1 qualifiers= |continentalcup2= |continentalcup2 qualifiers= |league topscorer=[[File: Colours of Wexford.svg|border|20px]] [[Ned Buggy]] (5-46) |best goalkeeper= |biggest home win= |biggest away win= |highest scoring= |matches= |total goals= |longest wins= |longest unbeaten= |longest winless= |longest losses= |highest attendance= |lowest attendance= |attendance= |average attendance= |prevseason=[[1976-77 National Hurling League|1976-77]] |nextseason=[[1978-79 National Hurling League|1978-79]] |updated=28 February 2017 }} [[Clare GAA|Clare]] came into the season as defending champions of the [[1976-77 National Hurling League|1976-77 season]]. [[Westmeath GAA|Westmeath]] entered Division 1 as the promoted team. On 30 April 1978, Clare won the title after a 3-10 to 1-10 win over [[Kilkenny GAA|Kilkenny]] in the final. It was their third league title overall and their second in succession.{{cite web|url=http://www.clarepeople.com/2013/02/21/in-a-league-of-their-own/|title=In a league of their own|publisher=Clare People|date=21 February 2013|accessdate=28 February 2017|first=Joe|last=Ó Muircheartaigh}} Westmeath were relegated from Division 1 after just one season in the top flight. ===Division 1A table=== {| class="wikitable" style="text-align: centre;" |- !width=20|Pos !width=150|Team !width=20|Pld !width=20|W !width=20|D !width=20|L !width=20|Pts !width=250|Notes |- style="background:gold;" |'''1'''||align=left|''' [[Clare GAA|Clare]] '''||'''6'''||'''3'''||'''1'''||'''2'''||'''7'''|| Division 1 champions |- style="background:silver;" |'''2'''||align=left|''' [[Kilkenny GAA|Kilkenny]] '''||'''6'''||'''3'''||'''0'''||'''3'''||'''6'''|| Division 1 runners-up |- style |'''3'''||align=left|''' [[Wexford GAA|Wexford]] '''||'''6'''||'''3'''||'''0'''||'''3'''||'''6''' |- |'''4'''||align=left|''' [[Galway GAA|Galway]] '''||'''6'''||'''3'''||'''0'''||'''3'''||'''6''' |- |'''5'''||align=left|''' [[Offaly GAA|Offaly]] '''||'''6'''||'''3'''||'''0'''||'''3'''||'''6''' |- style="background:pink;" |'''6'''||align=left|''' [[Cork GAA|Cork]] '''||'''6'''||'''3'''||'''0'''||'''3'''||'''6'''|| Relegated to Division 1B |- style="background:pink;" |'''7'''||align=left|''' [[Tipperary GAA|Tipperary]] '''||'''6'''||'''2'''||'''1'''||'''3'''||'''5'''|| Relegated to Division 1B |} ===Group stage results=== {{football box collapsible |date = 9 October 1977 |round = |team1 = [[Clare GAA|Clare]] |score = 4-13 -
